prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless square PBR base-color material texture for green hydroponic crop leaves in a realistic lunar habitat 3D simulation.
Primary request: a full-bleed continuous scan of fresh muted medium-green biological leaf tissue. Dense incredibly fine branching tiny veins and lifelike translucent cellular epidermis. A physically plausible living plant material with fine organic microstructure and subtle natural green pigment variation. Tiny branching vein hierarchy is visible uniformly across the swatch, with NO dominant central midrib.
Style/medium: exceptionally realistic macro photograph / scientific botanical material scan, actual photographed leaf surface texture. Sharp fine focus everywhere, absolutely no illustration, CGI or stylization.
Composition/framing: one square 2048 x 2048 texture. Orthographic straight-on scan. A single continuous material fills every pixel. Perfectly tileable with matching opposite edges. No individual leaf shape or silhouette, no leaf edges, no stems, no objects, no background, no overlap of leaves, no border, no grid.
Lighting: uniform neutral diffuse cross-polarized illumination, de-lit base-color/albedo map. No sunlight patches, no specular spots, no cast shadows, no vignette, no strong brightness gradient and no water droplets.
Color: refined natural green, restrained saturation, small realistic cellular variation, consistent average color over the entire square.
Constraints: tiny organic botanical veins and epidermal cells only. No text, symbols, numbers, logos, insects, disease spots, flowers or decorative patterns. One independent full-bleed opaque material texture; not a preview sphere or a scene.
qa: Inspected generated image. Full-bleed green tissue with fine branching veins; no leaf silhouette, stem, background or text. Even overall exposure and no cast shadows.
